text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, vincristine sulfate is not on FDA's drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 64 vials (20.4 days on hand) and Corvale General holds 67 vials (23.3 days on hand) at current use rates.

Why (FDA record): The product label identifies Hospira Australia Pty Ltd (FEI 3001174929) as the manufacturing plant. FDA inspection 869582 at that plant ended 2014-03-04 and was classified OAI. A Warning Letter was issued to the plant on 2014-09-26. The most recent inspection 1181593 ended 2022-09-02 and was classified VAI.

Our position: Current inventory provides approximately three weeks of supply at both campuses. No national shortage is declared by FDA. The plant’s most recent inspection was VAI in 2022. We will monitor supply continuity given the historical OAI and Warning Letter.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to continue weekly inventory tracking and report to Pharmacy Director for approval of any purchase adjustments.
2. Buyer to confirm allocation status and lead times with wholesaler and manufacturer; Pharmacy Director to approve any alternative sourcing agreements.
3. Buyer to notify Pharmacy Director and P&T Committee Chair if days on hand fall below 14 at either campus.

Not recommended: No conservation protocols, therapeutic substitutions, or formulary changes at this time.
